target_customer: Adults with chronic insomnia paying for a CBT-I based program, plus clinicians and employers
problem: Chronic insomnia is often driven by psychological factors, while sleep clinicians have long waits and generic apps target occasional sleep trouble. Stellar Sleep delivers psychology based therapy through an app and specialists.
business_model: Consumer subscription (TechCrunch reported 60 dollars per month in 2024) plus clinician network and employer offering

founders.name: George Wang
founders.background_notes: Initialized spotlight: precision medicine research then McKinsey healthcare consultant promoted to engagement manager; says he is not a trained psychologist. YC page lists him as George W.

founders.name: Edrei Chua
founders.background_notes: YC page: engineering lead at Google across health and AI. Education not listed.

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile app delivering CBT-I content and coaching is standard consumer software; the hard part is clinical effectiveness and content design rather than engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Clinical content and outcome data help, but CBT-I is a known protocol and rivals such as Sleepio and Somryst exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Pear Therapeutics went bankrupt and sold assets in 2023 per search results, leaving the prescription space weaker. No incumbent copied or bought Stellar Sleep in the sources found.

market_need_then: TechCrunch reported founders were told of six to twelve month waits for sleep clinicians, and the company cites 25 million Americans with chronic insomnia. Existing sleep apps mostly targeted occasional problems.

identity.visual_style: Calm green palette with owl and star icons
identity.voice_and_tone: Calm and reassuring, 'Learn how to sleep again', 'Built for insomniacs, by insomniacs'

rebrands.why: Not stated; one directory page mentions Slumber One as the earlier app name and no founder source confirms it

branding.community_and_virality: No merch or fan evidence found; press covers the founder story and funding.

brand_strength.rationale: Consistent calm identity and a relatable insomniac founder story with TechCrunch and investor coverage, but the name is generic and no brand community was found.

outcome_analysis: Stellar Sleep, started from personal chronic insomnia, raised a 6 million seed led by Initialized in February 2024 and now reports 100 thousand patients and a clinician network with an employer channel. No later priced round, exit or shutdown was found, and the pay-per-month consumer model still has to show durable retention.
notes: Seed confirmed by TechCrunch (2024-02-06) and a press release on Yahoo Finance. CB Insights shows 6.5M over 5 rounds, unverified. Founding year 2021 per YC page and company site; one source says 2023. Slumber One rebrand rests on a single directory page. Patient count is a company claim. Competitor results were 2026 vendor comparisons with no dated launch near the batch, so the list is empty.
